notes: Important fix: updating LATYS no longer wipes your settings — the installer now runs fully isolated from your app data and closes the running app gracefully before copying files. Includes everything from 0.1.31: LATYS Remote phone control (latys.app/remote), the ⌘K command palette, calmer idle cockpit, mission summary cards with diff review, beat-reactive waveform visualizer, quick notepad, and canvas drawing.
